scenario.name: targeted subset (v4.15.0 plan §4), NOT perf/run.sh all: one-on-ones ceo/lead/hr, activity-log ceo/lead/hr, days-off lead/hr, impact-log lead/hr, succession hr, users-admin admin/ic/ceo, pulse-results hr, dashboard ceo, reviews-team-view ceo-all (1 VU, 3 iterations, a pgss window each, after an unrecorded 2-iteration warm-up of each, run v4150-warmup); no 50-VU run
scenario.web: perf/run.sh web pulse-results --persona hr | activity-log (all 10 cases) | org-chart | one-on-ones --persona ceo|lead|hr (5 measured iterations + a cold run each, 1x CPU) -> web/*.json (waterfalls dropped); compare with 2026-10-04-3076bbd4/web and 2026-10-04-ce513a41/web. The web runner has no days-off drill-down case and no 1:1 managed latest-only case.
scenario.webHarnessNote: pulse-results hr.results does NOT settle with the committed e2e/perf/harness.ts since W4: the lazy card trend charts leave a 200px Mantine Skeleton on every below-the-fold card until it is scrolled near the viewport, and waitSettled counts any rendered Skeleton (getClientRects) as loading -> 180 s timeout. web/pulse-results.hr.results.json was measured with a LOCAL, uncommitted one-line patch (a loader blocks only when its bounding rect intersects the viewport), reverted afterwards; hr.trend and hr.participation are from the unpatched harness.
scenario.report: report-vs-2026-10-04-ce513a41.md (pulse-results hr, one-on-ones ceo, users-admin, dashboard ceo, reviews-team-view ceo-all) and report-vs-2026-10-04-acd9d3ed.md (the drill-downs, absent from ce513a41); no RUN NOT CLEAN in either. Count increases, all explained: GET /teams +1 statement (the v4.14.0 grouped memberIds query, incl. every shell-probe); the activity endpoint +1..2 statements vs acd9d3ed (data-dependent hydration: fewer k6 sign-ins of the target persona before the window than in acd9d3ed's perf/run.sh all warm-up, so the first 20-row page reaches goal/share rows and runs their fact lookups — no activity code changed since acd9d3ed); users-admin statement calls of the users-list teams-enrichment query shift between pg_stat_statements IN-list-length text variants (total calls fall 42 -> 24 with the users pool gone).
scenario.knownNotClean: none: 0 failed requests and 0 responses without Server-Timing in every run
scenario.pgssLatestOnly: the CEO's one-on-ones?view=managed&latestOnly=true row statement: 42.1 ms mean / 1 042 728 buffers hit for 3 calls (2026-10-04-ce513a41) -> 0.154 ms mean / 294 buffers hit for 3 calls (separate window, run v4150-pgss, read straight from pg_stat_statements — too cheap to make the committed top-50 CSV)
scenario.summaries: reduced to the metrics scripts/perf_compare.py reads; no tokens (the JWT-prefix grep is empty)

caveat: OrbStack on one laptop is not production: compare milliseconds relatively, statement/transaction counts exactly. Baselines compare only within one datasetVersion.
fixes: v4.15.0: F12 (1:1 latestOnly as a DISTINCT ON subquery + V92 pair-latest index — CEO managed-latest 47 -> 3 ms p50, statement 42.1 -> 0.15 ms; 6 stmt / 2 tx unchanged), F9 (drill-down headings: one users?id= lookup instead of the six-page users pool — every drill-down 5 requests and ~40-50 statements / 10 tx fewer; the Teams screen's manager filter from the teams rows — 11 -> 6 requests, 71 -> 21 stmt), F16 (pulse: results 10 -> 9 stmt, trend 8/6 -> 6/5, comments 7 -> 6), W4 (lazy card trend charts: HR results screen 259 -> 178 requests, 2 120 -> 1 298 stmt, 1 613 -> 1 124 tx, k6 1 115 -> 294 ms; web 1 800 -> 677 ms settled, 3 trend requests instead of 84), W6 (the drill-down web screens 11 -> 6 requests, settled ~300 ms).
